text:
lina: Hey team — Spectra just signed the NDA (link here: https://spectra.co/nda). They want an early-access run next month to validate perf on their A100-like boards and give feedback on our runtime. Need quick alignment on benchmarks + telemetry.

owen-eng: Quick Q — which models are they bringing? small/medium/xxl? KV cache export?

josh: We're assuming a mix: LLaMA-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and one large 70B for tail cases. Bench plan I sketched: warmup, steady-state throughput, p99 tail latency, memory sweep.

maria: For connectivity, we'll need CIDR allowlist and a short-lived SSH jumpbox. Also want to confirm KMS/HSM access pattern for keys.

anna-legal: I redlined section 3.2 (telemetry + aggregated logs). Spectra asked for perf logs; we need strict PIIs excluded. I uploaded the redline: https://redwood.atl/legal/spectra-nda-v2. Suggested clause: aggregated perf only, 30d retention.

samir: From infra side — can we do an isolated pool under Dedicated for this? If yes, I can reserve two GPU nodes and enable KV cache snapshots. Need exact sequence lengths to pick kernel paths.

lina: Good catch Anna. Samir, Dedicated pool sounds right for capacity isolation. Owen/Josh, can you confirm what sequence lengths and batch shapes we'll run? Also list any special perf counters we need exposed.

owen-eng: For kernel selection let's aim for seq=512 (main), 1024 (stress), and short 64 for chat-like flows. Expose: per-step latency, memory alloc delta, CUDA SM utilization, and kv-cache hit/miss.

josh: I'll add those to the bench harness. Example load command (rough):

```
# run rbench against spectrahw
rbench --model llama-2-13b --concurrency 16 --seq 512 --duration 5m --collect perf_counters
```

I'll attach the harness in the repo by EOD.

maria: Need a mapping for ports and the jumpbox user accounts. Also request: enable flow logs for those subnets.

tia-partner: Thanks, Lina team. Spectra can provide firmware logs and power telemetry. They prefer aggregated results with anonymized traces. They can support HSM integration for key wrapping; will confirm the timeline (probably week of May 6).

anna-legal: Spectra please confirm redline acceptance or list required changes. If they accept, we'll sign and spin up infra.

platform-bot: <jira-redwood-1234> created: SPECTRA-EAP-1 - dedicated pool + bench harness (assignee: josh).

samir: Action items from infra: reserve 2x nodes (A100 equiv), create dedicated subnet, enable flow logs, KV snapshot toggle. ETA: 3 business days after NDA signed.

lina: Owners: Josh = bench harness + scripts, Owen = runtime knobs + perf counters, Samir = infra provisioning, Anna = legal signoff, Maria = network & access, Tia = Spectra contact for firmware logs.

josh: I'll post the preliminary numbers to the JIRA and ping here when the harness is ready. Expect first smoke in ~10 days. :rocket:

tia-partner: We'll try to accelerate on our side. Also want a 30-min sync with runtime team next Tues — can we do 10am PT?

lina: 10am PT works. I'll send calendar invite and include agenda: bench plan, telemetry schema, access checklist. :calendar:

owen-eng: One more: if we hit a perf regression vs our baseline, auto-fallback policy should route to CPU fallback or smaller model. Josh — can we test fallback in the harness?

josh: Yep — will add a simple policy test.

lina: Great — thanks all. Keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
